Use case: product-mockup
Product: 포레스트 아치 북엔드
Design invariants: Fictional concept sample. One single L-shaped steel bookend, upright plate with rounded arch top and one centered circular hole near top, plain rectangular horizontal base extending forward, matte forest green, no hinges despite any naming. No logos or lettering. Preserve shape and all hardware counts.
Base color: forest green
Base material: powder-coated steel
Studio: warm light gray seamless studio, soft diffused daylight
One adult model wearing the exact referenced garment, full body front view, relaxed neutral stance, garment unobstructed.
One separate photorealistic image only; no collage, text, logos or watermark. Reference images are authoritative. Preserve garment shape, seams, collar, pockets and closures unless explicitly changing that property. For edits change only the requested angle, pose, color or material. Do not depict multiple variants together.

history.note: Accepted usage: one bookend supports exactly three upright blank linen books, rectangular base visibly under books, arch and circular hole retained.
